name: claude-multi
description: Cross-OS system-tray app to run Claude Code under multiple isolated accounts.
author: Lucas Donadio

scripts.install-cli: cd src-tauri && cargo build --release --bin cms && mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" && cp "$(pwd)/target/release/cms" "$HOME/.local/bin/cms" && echo 'cms installed to ~/.local/bin/cms (re-run install-cli after rebuilding)' && case ":$PATH:" in *":$HOME/.local/bin:"*) ;; *) echo 'warning: ~/.local/bin is not in your PATH — add it to your shell profile' ;; esac
